title: SPLA/122/2018 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Prakash Pandey Alias P.p. AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
SPLA No.122/2018 IN GA No.63 OF 2018
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. V. K. Jemini, Deputy
Advocate General for the State of
Uttarakhand/appellant.
Mr. D. S. Mehta, Advocate for
the respondent.
Cause shown for the delay in
filing the appeal is sufficient. Delay in
filing the Govt. Appeal on behalf of the
State is condoned. Delay Condonation
Application No.1475/2018 is allowed
accordingly.
Present application No.122 of
2018 has been filed by the appellant-State seeking leave to file appeal
against the judgment and order dated
20.12.2017 passed by the 1st Addl.
Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District
Nainital in S.T. No.72 of 2011, State
vs. Prakash Pandey @ P.P. & another,
whereby the accused/respondents
were acquitted from the charges
levelled against them under Sections
302, 201, 364,120-B IPC.
Perused the impugned judgment
and order.
Considering the facts of the case
and after perusal of the impugned
judgment, this Court is of the view
that Application No.122/2018 seeking
leave to file appeal against the
impugned judgment should be allowed.
Therefore, Application No.122/2018
seeking leave to file appeal against the
impugned judgment is hereby allowed.

Admit.
Summon the L.C.R.
After receiving the LCR, the
Registry shall prepare the paper-book
and supply the same to learned
counsel for the parties, as per rules.
